name: Forward Waltz
notes: Forward, side, close. The side step travels diagonally forward on a 3-4-5 triangle (0.3 across for 0.4 forward, 0.5 travelled), so its direction is atan2(0.3, 0.4) = 36.8699 degrees from forward, and the moving foot finishes level with the one that stepped forward. It carries the waltz rise.
